name: Miss Green FIT ME Waterproof Mascara & Eyeliner | 2-in-1 Long-Lasting Eye Makeup Duo
description:
Enhance your eyes effortlessly with the Miss Green FIT ME Waterproof Mascara & Eyeliner 2-in-1 Duo, designed for bold definition, intense color, and all-day waterproof wear. This smudge-proof, sweat-proof formula keeps your eye makeup flawless, whether you're at work, at the gym, or out in the rain. The precise eyeliner tip creates sharp, clean lines while the mascara lifts, lengthens, and volumizes lashes for a dramatic finish.Key Features:
 2-in-1 waterproof mascara and eyeliner
 Long-lasting, smudge-proof, and humidity-resistant
 Precise eyeliner for sharp wings
 Mascara adds length, lift, and volume
 Suitable for all eye shapes and daily useHow to Use:
1⃣ Apply eyeliner using light strokes to create your desired line.
2⃣ Sweep mascara from root to tip for full lash coverage.
3⃣ Build layers for added drama.
4⃣ Remove with an oil-based makeup remover.Ingredients:
Aqua, Iron Oxides, Beeswax, Glycerin, Acrylates Copolymer, Carnauba Wax, Vitamin E, Safe Cosmetic Pigments.Safety Information:
 Avoid direct contact with eyes.
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
 For external use only.
 Store in a cool, dry place.

Package Includes:
 1 × Miss Green FIT ME Waterproof Mascara
 1 × Miss Green FIT ME Waterproof Eyeliner
